subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should zero-payload turns with `lastToolError` show the generic incomplete-turn fallback in addition to or instead of a tool-error warning?
rationale: The remaining source gap is real, but changing fallback precedence for tool errors affects user-visible channel error policy and should align with maintainer intent before a fix PR changes terminal-turn semantics.

options.title: Allow fallback for zero-payload tool errors
options.body: Permit the incomplete-turn fallback when no payloads were delivered, while preserving existing suppression once any user-facing payload or committed delivery exists.

options.title: Keep tool errors suppressing fallback
options.body: Treat `lastToolError` as terminal policy and leave this issue open only for better exec warning delivery or docs of the intended behavior.

options.title: Unify warning and incomplete-turn policy first
options.body: Defer a code fix until maintainers redesign how tool-error warnings, terminal fallback text, and retry safety compose.

recommendation.title: Allow fallback for zero-payload tool errors
recommendation.body: Permit the incomplete-turn fallback when no payloads were delivered, while preserving existing suppression once any user-facing payload or committed delivery exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The structured terminal fallback refactor is the broadest recent decision surface for this policy choice.
